lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Spatial distribution of high-luminance circular pixel clusters forming approximately seven visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible in the mid-flank, aligning with high-luminance spots to create a rectangular grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature in the upper third of the visible flank showing a distinct luminance gradient with light pixels above a shadowed trough.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a high-luminance linear feature extending from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin into the surrounding medium.
other_distinctive_markers: Labyrinthine pattern of interconnected low-diameter high-luminance clusters situated in the cephalic-lateral transition zone anterior to the gill slits.
